resources.string: Swipe down from the top edge of the bottom screen to open WalkThor, and swipe again to put it away. While a game is running, it also taps the very top edge of the game\'s screen once after WalkThor opens or after you search, which hands the game back Android\'s top performance priority. Optionally, only while the Face Buttons screen is open (after you agree), it sees your controller button presses to light up the matching buttons, passing every press straight on to the game. Optionally, only if you turn on Open when an emulator starts, it notes which app comes to the front and, for the running emulator only, its window title and notifications, to tell which game you\'re playing; nothing is kept after the game ends. Optionally, only if you turn on Recognise the game you pick, it is told the names of what you highlight or select in other apps, keeping only the last few in memory for under a minute to tell which game you launched from your frontend. Otherwise it doesn\'t read, store or change what\'s on your screen, and doesn\'t keep any presses.
